# Quality Indicators

This area groups the clinical quality indicators used by the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) registry to monitor and evaluate the standard of care for IBD patients across Denmark. It currently covers indicators specific to IBD, tracking a wide range of clinical and operational metrics such as the timeliness of diagnostic workups for adults and children, post-operative follow-ups, patient education rates, and the systematic monitoring of patients on biological therapies or those requiring surgery.

## Pages

- [[topics/quality-indicators/ibd/index|Ibd]] — Catalogs the specific DANIBD registry indicators (Indikator 1 through 7) that measure diagnostic completeness, patient education, surgical follow-ups, biological therapy monitoring, and re-operation rates across Danish hospitals.
